evidence: CONFIRMED_CONTENT: SmoothPowerMomentMatrix.Family.compact_inverse_jet_bound, SmoothPowerMomentMatrix.lean:184 (also compact_inverse_jets_bound L197): (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U); Family fields bump_nonnegative, bump_support, separated hold ∀ p ∈ U (L93-111); integral_contDiffOn_of_moving_support (L26) also needs IsOpen U.

CONVENTION: SmoothPowerMomentMatrix.Family, SmoothPowerMomentMatrix.lean:100-105: lower_continuous, upper_continuous : ContinuousOn (fun p => lower/upper p j) U; separated : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ i j, i < j → upper p i < lower p j

I read p.34, Lemma A.1 (p.126) and the Lean sources myself. bumpMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero proves invertibility under weaker hypotheses than the paper's (continuity instead of smoothness), and because of the supports the full-line integral equals ∫_0^∞. In Data, inverseNorm, quadraticNorm and debtNorm are exactly ν_k, q_k and ‖d‖_{C^k}, using the CK max-derivative norm with the sup norm on Fin m→ℝ. Small is exactly the printed condition. exists_smooth_same_branch gives a smooth solution, uniqueness in the C^0 ball and the C^k bound. linear_solution covers Q=0. The family clause (compact_inverse_jet(s)_bound) needs an open domain, which is a confirmed low finding. It also needs continuous endpoints, which is a CONVENTION following A.1. I added compact_inverse_jets_bound (L197). MomentRepair.exists_unique_small_correction is at L206, not L153.

findings.summary: The family clause needs every hypothesis (nonnegativity, support, separation) on an open U containing K. A family given only on the compact set [-1,1], smooth up to the endpoints, is not covered and may have no admissible extension.

Family also requires continuous lower/upper endpoints with upper p i < lower p j. Lemma 4.7's wording only asks that the hypotheses hold at each parameter, so smooth families without continuously choosable separating intervals are excluded.
